findings.summary: The 'unknown job' error the land_pr tests expect does not exist.
findings.evidence: Records::resolve fails with `no job matches {reference:?}; `athena status` lists them`. No 'unknown job' text appears in it. Criterion 4 says resolve 'fails with 'unknown job''. As written, the tests would either fail or quietly assert a different message. Fix: Choose one: change the resolve error to include 'unknown job' and update any tests that match the old text, or have the land_pr tests assert the real message and state the difference in the change description. Also note that land_pr is a method (Athena::land_pr(job_ref, runner, poll, ui)), not resolve(job_ref). With a refusing runner, the success case will still fail later, so the test must assert that the error is not the no-match error.

findings.summary: Nine reader files stay unmoved, and the plan does not say how the scan's real-tree-clean test passes with them.
findings.evidence: The request is to move every records/ reader. Decision 7 leaves code_health.rs, work_decisions.rs, steward.rs, hestia.rs, scope_guard.rs, watcher.rs, audience.rs, review.rs and drain.rs unmoved. Any of their current-records loads will trip the scan unless allow-listed. Allow-listing them would contradict criterion 7's narrowing and the 'every reader' wording. Fix: Say explicitly, for each unmoved site, whether it is a historical/treeish read (allowed, with a reason) or a current read. Either move the current reads, or add (file, function) allow-list entries marked as D111 follow-ups. List them in the change description and CHANGELOG so criterion 9's 'every reader found by grep' holds.
findings.location: Decision 7 (NOT MOVED list) and Decision 9 / Criterion 7 records_reader_scan_real_tree_clean

findings.summary: The common-dir and per-repo state-dir helpers already exist. The plan should reuse them, not re-derive them in athena-data.
findings.evidence: athena_git::Git::common_dir() runs `rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir`, and paths::repo_state_dir(common_git_dir) keys the state dir by it. athena-data has no git dependency (Cargo.toml lists none), and xtask main.rs:435 already runs the same rev-parse. Fix: Add only records_worktree_dir(repo_state_dir) plus the selector to paths.rs. Callers get the common dir from Git::common_dir() (backtest.rs, and walltime.rs through xtask's existing athena-git dependency). Describe the new code as wiring these helpers into readers that lacked them.

findings.summary: The open question about xtask's dependencies is already answered.
findings.evidence: xtask/Cargo.toml lists athena-data and athena-git under [dependencies]. Fix: Drop the open question and the fallback of a local rev-parse.

findings.summary: The plan is muddled about where the state dir comes from.
findings.evidence: paths.rs:35 takes state_root from ATHENA_STATE_DIR, and repo_state_dir adds a key derived from the common dir. The worktree therefore lives at <ATHENA_STATE_DIR>/<name>-<hash>/records-worktree. The fixture must compute that path the same way the binary does. Fix: Have the fixture build the worktree path with paths::repo_state_dir(common_dir) under the temporary ATHENA_STATE_DIR, and assert it is under that directory.

summary: The plan follows the reading. It puts the walltime tests in xtask and the land_pr tests in gh.rs, and it uses distinct W/T job ids so each test shows which record was read. I checked it against the snapshot. Two major problems would leave criteria unshown. First, criterion 4 requires the error 'unknown job', but Records::resolve says "no job matches …", and the plan never changes or handles that text. Second, nine files that read records are left unmoved, and the plan never says how records_reader_scan's real-tree-clean test passes with them still in the tree. Three smaller points. The common-dir and state-dir helpers the plan calls "new" already exist in athena-git and paths.rs. The open question about xtask reaching athena-data is already answered: xtask depends on athena-data and athena-git. Decision 2 says the state dir comes from git's common dir, but it is actually set by ATHENA_STATE_DIR plus that key, and the wording is muddled. Everything else checks out: the files, Rig/FakeHost in gh.rs, the load at gh.rs:2513 and walltime::read_jobs all exist. records_reader_scan does not exist yet, so the plan correctly adds it.
